uwuuwuuwu.text: UwUUwUUwU is a patient powerhouse: matchup rating and resistance both among the very best, with a matchup K/D line in the same neighborhood. uou666.text: UOU666 arrived recently and already fights at the highest level: belongs near the top of the tracked board on nearly every measure, a brisk clip, and unflinching as fights harden. The numbers soften as the opposition strengthens. The form thins against the strongest third too. Still early, and the first pages already carry weight.

ultramaxvs.text: UltramaxVS plays like a metronome set to lethal: the matchup mark, the tempo, and the clash with tougher enemies all land near the summit, while accuracy sits up there too, while the lifetime ledger paints the same picture. Consistency runs well above average, so the edge holds against the strongest third. Read this one as a sketch, though — the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller than the usual record.
